auth.hint: 密码在 ComfyUI 的 CHP 插件配置节点里设置。

description.zh: 把画布当作参考图重绘一张 512 × 512 的速写稿。
description.en: Redraw the canvas as a 512 × 512 sketch.

description.zh: 只重画白色蒙版覆盖的区域, 其余部分原样保留。
description.en: Repaint only the white mask area and keep everything else.

description.zh: 把画布放大到 1024 或 2048 并补细节。
description.en: Upscale the canvas to 1024 or 2048 and add detail.

description.zh: 给一张图（定妆照、姿势骨架、随手一张照片）加一句描述，重画成一张成品图。
description.en: Give it a picture — a character sheet, a pose skeleton, any photo — plus a line of text, and it repaints it into a finished image.

description.zh: 只给一句描述，从零画一张成品图，不带任何参考图。
description.en: A line of text and nothing else — a finished picture drawn from scratch, with no reference image at all.

help.zh: 要哪个功能场景。取值见信息文档的 rules。
help.en: Which functional scenario. The information document's rules list them.

help.zh: 输出画幅, 写成 "宽x高"(如 "768x1344")。必填, 且只能取该类别帧表里列出的值 —— 低/中/高三档, 顺序就是帧表里的顺序。
help.en: Output canvas as "WxH" (e.g. "768x1344"). Required, and only a value from that category's frames — low/mid/high, in the order the frames list them.

help.zh: 画面描述。是否需要先译成英文由 rules[].prompt.language 决定。
help.en: What to draw. Whether it must be English first is the rule's prompt.language.

help.zh: 0 表示每张都不一样; 同一个值可以复现。
help.en: 0 means a new seed each run; the same value reproduces.

help.zh: 0.05–0.95, 越大越贴近参考图, 越低越放手重画。越界会被夹到边界。
help.en: 0.05–0.95. Higher stays closer to the reference, lower redraws more freely. Out of range is clamped.

help.zh: 参考图, PNG/JPEG 的 base64, 可直接给 data URL。只有规则里带 ref 的场景收它(见 rules[].signature); 纯文生图那条收了会被拒。
help.en: Reference image as base64 PNG/JPEG; a data URL is accepted as-is. Only rules whose signature contains ref take it; the text-to-image rule refuses it.

help.zh: 蒙版, 黑底白区, 白色 = 要重画。
help.en: Mask, black background with a white area; white means repaint.

help.zh: 模型层的扩展参数, 原样携带、原样回显。规范不定义任何字段。
help.en: Model-layer extension parameters, carried and echoed verbatim. The spec defines no field in it.

help.zh: CHP 层的扩展参数。目前只有 password。
help.en: CHP-layer extension parameters. Today only password.

help.zh: 可选。这次提交自己的编号, 由客户端生成。重发同一次提交时沿用同一个值, 服务端就还你**原来那个作业**, 不会再排一个; 换了内容就要换一个值。
help.en: Optional. The client's own id for this submission. Send the same value when retrying the same submission and the server answers with the original job instead of queueing a second one; use a new value when the content changes.
